items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Yes, I knew John Kirby. John Kirby, why, I first saw him with Fletcher's band in 1930 down in Cincinnati

ctx.x: And the bass player then was John Kirby. He was nothing but a kid at the time. And the guitar player was Clarence Holliday, which is Billie Holliday's father.
